in_sanskrit.name: अनंगमयी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess of the Blissful, Ananga (Ananga means 'blissful', mayi means 'goddess')

in_hindi.name: अनंगमयी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनंग (Ananga) + मायी (Mayi) = अनंगमयी (Anangmayi) अनंग (Ananga) के अर्थ व्यक्ति को अनंग (अस्थीतल) से मोक्ष देने वाली माया देवता के नाम है।

in_tamil.name: அனங்கமயி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Anangamayi is the name of the goddess who bestows liberation from physical bondage.

in_telugu.name: అనంగమేయి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Anangamēyi is the name of the goddess who grants liberation from physical bondage.

in_marathi.name: Anangmayi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Graceful form of Ananga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anangmayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anangmayi is a graceful form of Ananga, which means 'without body' or 'formless'. This name is revered in Hindu culture, especially in the tradition of Shakti worship.
